enunciado: A 7-vertex graph has the edges 0-1, 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6. Label each vertex with its component number using DFS and show how many components there are and which vertices form each one.
objetivos: Start traversals from every unvisited vertex
pistas: Every time you find an unlabelled vertex, start a new component.
The DFS from that vertex labels its whole component.
